Hinweise: Needed by UdsTransportProtocolHandler implementation to fill the UdsMessage with data in RX path. I.e. UdsTransportProtocolHandler implementation gets the UdsMessage instance from a call to UdsTransportProtocolMgr::IndicateMessage() and then calls this method on it and writes into the returned uds_transport::ByteVector.
